entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: An Angel of Innistrad captured, exsanguinated and bled dry in Shilgengar's Ritual.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon who manipulated Edgar Markov into experimenting with blood magic.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: An aging human alchemist manipulated by Shilgengar into blood magic.

entities.name: Shilgengar's Ritual
entities.description: The ritual in which Marycz's magic-infused blood was distributed to Innistrad's nobility, turning them into immortal vampires.

events.summary: Shilgengar manipulates Edgar Markov into experimenting with blood magic as famine sweeps the land.
events.quote: the demon Shilgengar manipulated the aging human alchemist Edgar Markov into experimenting with blood magic

events.summary: Marycz is captured, dragged into Edgar's library and exsanguinated, her blood given to the nobility, who become vampires.
events.quote: she was bled dry, and her blood was infused with magic

relations.quote: Marycz was captured, dragged into Edgar's library, and exsanguinated.
